motion: tau=0.2 damped; continuous last-two initial velocity
request_payload: single timestamp centroid and validity; failed payload charged and disclosed at due time
known_clock: original timestamp grid and fixed mask endpoint known equally to policies
arrival: exact request time + delay; process before first scoring timestamp at/after due; zero delay before scoring
terminal: allow return on last scoring point; report terminal benefit separately
missing_information: hide trajectories, derivatives and quality flags except returned payload validity
main_reference: qualified continuous windows; ideal qualified returns; natural bad intervals descriptive only
scale: source median valid hand-centroid to head distance, both hands and training timestamps pooled; exclude global held env for OOF
metrics: frame-mean ADE primary, FDE, within-window P95 (not global P95), tolerance rate, pointwise coverage, diameter, cost, pending and no-request waiting, compute
test_use: index only until freeze; final evaluation separate
official_conventions: missing_observation_experiments.md not found locally; numeric resource choices participant defined
